lenses.name: Electricity use
lenses.description: Total published 2025 electricity consumption on the Enedis distribution network per resident. Commune-level totals aggregate residential and economic activity; they are not household-only consumption. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune; this is a commune-level approximation, not meter locations. Enedis does not serve Corsica, overseas France and some local-distribution areas. Privacy-withheld rows are absent rather than zero; customer-class lenses omit commune populations where that class has no published row.

lenses.name: Residential electricity share
lenses.description: Residential consumption as a share of all 2025 electricity consumption in each commune aggregate. High values usually indicate housing-dominated territories; low values often indicate industrial, tertiary or agricultural load. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune; this is a commune-level approximation, not meter locations. Enedis does not serve Corsica, overseas France and some local-distribution areas. Privacy-withheld rows are absent rather than zero; customer-class lenses omit commune populations where that class has no published row.

lenses.name: Electric heating
